player_prompt.intro:
Selamatu ri Danau Mabusa!

Rikauwéwé ri tanda 'P' ri atas jaring.
Tanda jaring:
  ' ' = Pamukaan mabusa (aman ri laleng)
  'H' = Lubang (taro'no ri kale!) 
  'G' = Tujuan (sassuwi ri menang!)
  'P' = Posiwiwéwé rikauwéwé

Aksiwéwé: makkilo, tuwi, kiri, kanan (atawa w, a, s, d)
Tulisi aksiwéwé ri: [up], [down], [left], [right] atau [w], [a], [s], [d]

Tujuan: Navigasiwiwé ri awal (kiri-atas) ri tujuan (kanan-bawah) ri laleng tana makkasauwi lubang!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format aksi tidak sah. Gunakan [up], [down], [left], [right] atau [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Aksi de'na riisseng '{action}'. Pakkegunai menre, mariawa, abessi, ataunna, iyyarega w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Muttemmu ri laleng liang! Tamatta'na. Pura mutungke {pct}% pole allalengeng lao ri pattepu'.
outcome.turn_limit: Miu reppa' batasan giliran! Akka' pattaungeng. Miu mappattae {pct}% ri tala'ea ri laleng ka pole.
